description: MAINE — The campaign of Hannah Pingree, former Speaker of the House and the Democratic nominee for Governor, today announced four statewide televised debates this fall, giving Mainers the chance to see all three candidates for governor on the same stage ahead of the November election.

title: Hannah Pingree Announces General Election Debate Schedule - Hannah Pingree for Governor
